Another 20+ are false because the file's revision is a hash (`b81bfc888610`, `837e1e29bd49`, ...) while the filename is timestamp-prefixed — the `TIMESTAMP_RE` branch (:62-67) demands the hash start with `YYYYMMDD_HHMM`, which no Alembic-generated hash revision ever does. It is wired as a pre-commit hook (.pre-commit-config.yaml:58-63, `files: ^backend/alembic/versions/.*\.py$`), so any commit touching a migration file will fail on ~71 spurious errors. The audit's '64/66 = 97%' figure counts this tool's output, not the rule.
